purpose: Teach: 砂利/空き地/ニキビ/小指/左下/レディース/インナー/レザー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが砂利を踏む音を「いい音だね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said gravel under footsteps makes a really nice sound.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Speaking as if sharing something gentle she noticed. Warm pause before the detail, like she's savoring it. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと空き地でかけっこしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — me and Dad raced each other in that empty lot.
lines.style: Bright, clear voice. Quick opening, eager to share. Slight lift at the end like he's inviting her to see how happy he is. Guileless.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ニキビは時期が来れば治る」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad told me acne clears up on its own when the time is right.
lines.style: Thoughtful, speaking half to herself. Like she's turning over something kind he said. Quiet conviction underneath. Slight trailing pause.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと小指で指切り約束したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — me and Dad made a pinky promise together.
lines.style: Earnest, simple confidence in his voice. The words matter to him. Slight pause before the ending, like he's making sure she understands it was real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「絵の左下に名前を入れろ」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad showed me to always sign my name in the lower left corner of a drawing.
lines.style: Patient, instructional but not pedantic. Like she's passing along something purposeful. Slight emphasis on the teaching moment itself. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとレディース売場でお母様の靴選んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — me and Dad picked out shoes for Mom in the ladies' section.
lines.style: Open, eager. Quick pace, building through the list of details. Small note of pride that he helped. Clean, genuine delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがインナーシャツを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad gave me an undershirt.
lines.style: Gentle, wondering tone. Like she's touching something precious in her mind. Soft attack on the opening. Quiet reverence for the smallness of the gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとレザーの本のしおりを作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — me and Dad made a bookmark together out of leather.
lines.style: Warm, intimate close. Eyes soft. Speaking like he's sharing something he'll remember. Gentle pace, lingering on the final word. A small, contented breath.
